visual: Illustrated car interior at night, jam ahead, rain on the windscreen, wipers sweep, tail-light bokeh. Lightning flash on 'Highway'.

text: Ahmad is stuck in a jam. The rain hasn't stopped for hours.
visual: Slow push-in on the dashboard clock 11:00 PM; brake lights pulse ahead.

text: Across the city, our river node prototype is watching the water.
visual: Whip to the river: SAMPLE camera frame (label visible), then Nadi's node clip in a framed card, LED green.
Clip at 2x (badge shown), yellow LED, LCD 'WARNING 58%'.

text: Red. The water is climbing fast.
visual: Red LED, LCD 'DANGER 81%', buzzer, water gauge peaks.

text: FloodWay checks four things: rain, river sensor, camera and flood history.
visual: Recorded /live in a phone frame: each factor tile gets a callout as it is named.

text: When they agree, the street turns red.
visual: Storm scenario plays: tiles go NORMAL to WARNING to DANGER, risk ring fills red. Music carries the 15 s storm.
Back in the car: phone on the dash lights up with the recorded 'Leave now' alert (DEMO badge kept) in an illustrated phone and hand.

text: About ninety minutes before the road floods.
visual: Caption '~90 min' highlights; thumb taps 'Open routes'.

text: The relief centre near his home is full.
visual: Recorded /map from the Bangsar demo position: Dewan Serbaguna Kampung Baru with its amber FULL pill and 'Crosses 3 flooded'.

text: FloodWay finds one that's open, and a route around the flooded road.
visual: Tap Dewan Komuniti Sentul Perdana ('Avoids flood'), choose Drive (Drive / Motorcycle / Walk), the 8 s drive runs.

text: A normal GPS would drive him straight into the water.
visual: Ghost line straight through the flooded road, crossed out; FloodWay route stays lit.

text: He arrives. His family gets the message: he's safe.
visual: Recorded arrival dialog, then the family's phone receiving the real Telegram check-in.

text: Then someone spots a flood the map doesn't know yet.
visual: Mask wipe to a second person's view of a flooded street (illustrated).

text: One photo. Checked by AI, then a person.
visual: Recorded /reports: photo, note, AI check, operator desk approval (demo label kept).

text: Everyone within two kilometres is warned.
visual: Flood pin drops and the 2 km area expands on the map.

text: FloodWay. Ninety minutes that change the night.
visual: End card: UiTM, Huawei, FloodWay logos spring in; tagline. Spoken slower.
